column1: # Realistic Stripe customer-balance histories for scripts/lib/stripe-credit.sh.
# Three separate holes were found in credit_live_window_eval by review, each one a
# case the existing fixtures could not express:
#   round 2 — a mixed balance (concession + tagged referral) over-reclaimed
#   round 4 — a post-remediation history reported spent concession as live
#   round 5 — netting ignored chronology, so a debit cancelled a concession that
# Every one was a MISSING FIXTURE before it was a missing guard. So the shapes are
# enumerated here as data rather than as prose, and each new shape is cheap to add.
# Rows are newest-first, exactly as the Stripe API returns them.
# `created` is present on every row: the helper must order by it, not by array
# position, so a payload that arrives out of order still nets correctly.
